messages.en: Wow, I'm finally off work…
Ichiran ramen.
I want to eat it so badly.
I want sushi too.
Oh, right!
I'm filming a vlog.
I've been capturing little everyday moments here and there,
but just thinking about editing it
makes me dizzy.
Oh, is it going to be another slightly cringe vlog this time too??
That's what makes it good.
Raw and unfiltered.
Still, since I'm always with Wavve during my schedules,
it's a little less tiring.

messages.ko: 오늘 넵툰이랑 제니스 같이 팬싸 했는데
messages.en: Today, Neptune and Zenith had a joint fansign,
and each time one unit was doing its session, the other had an hour or two to spare.
We took turns sleeping,
and the team that finished would wake up the sleeping team and send them off.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
It's funny but also kind of sad.
But your face still looked so fresh. That's amazing.
There must be 20 layers of powder on my face.

messages.ko: 많이 피곤하겠다 하연아...그치만 자는 장면도 브이로그에 담았지???😢😢
messages.en: You must be so tired, Hayeon... But you filmed yourself sleeping for the vlog too, right??? 😢😢
There is one shot.
Your face must feel heavy with 20 layers, Hayeon...
I want to get home and scrub it all off.
I did my own makeup today. How was it?
I gave it a try.

messages.ko: 셀프로 메이크업 할때 꿀팁이나 꼭 신경쓰는거 알려주랑
messages.en: Tell me some useful tips or things you always pay attention to when doing your own makeup.
The base.
If the base is too matte or too oily,

messages.ko: 그날 화장이 어떻게 되느냐가 달라지기 때뭉에
messages.en: it changes how the rest of your makeup turns out that day.
How did your base turn out today?
Today it's a little...
Sparkly idol style.
Glowing from within, but not oily.

messages.ko: 오늘 바지 길었는지 계속 걷어 올리더라ㅋㅋㅎㅋㅎㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ
messages.en: Your pants were so long today. You kept rolling them up ㅋㅋㅎㅋㅎㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋ
No, while I was dancing today,
my pants almost fell off.
I almost had to hide for the rest of my life.
Fumbling around, trying to fix them.
That's such a violent thing to say...
Y/n, let's go eat ramen.
Come on, let's go.
I told you we were going!
I'm already in line at Ichiran… When are you coming…..?
I'll be there soon~ Go on inside.
Save me a seat~
Have you had dinner??
I had a hamburger steak that was brought to the fansign venue.
It was really delicious.
It even had cheese inside.

messages.ko: 아까 리네랑 채원이는 편의점 간식으로 배때우고 있던데...
messages.en: Earlier, Rine and Chaewon were just filling up on convenience store snacks...
Whoa, does that even count as a meal?

messages.ko: 난 팬싸장 도시락 먹고 신라면 끓이고 카레까지 먹었어
messages.en: I ate the boxed meal at the fansign venue, cooked Shin Ramyun, and even had curry.
All in one meal.
I think I'll pass out as soon as I lie down in bed.
The new bed is so comfortable.
I still haven't picked a name for my hotel-bed friend,
but since it helps me sleep so well,
I got an error,
so I decided to name it Melatonin XIX.
I'll eat the pudding I bought at the convenience store and then go to sleep.
Y/n, oyasumi.
Haranghae ❤️❤️
